 INTERNET OUTAGE — Areas around the county are experienced internet outages on Tuesday, Nov. 10.
 Facebook 
 Twitter 
 WhatsApp

 Email 
 Print 
 Copy article link 
 Save 
 Widespread internet outages that began in the early morning hours of Tuesday, Nov. 10 caused disruptions around the county. 
 Spectrum internet customers have reported outages in and around downtown Waynesville, with some outages reaching as far as Canton. 
 So far, the interruption has impacted the Haywood Regional Medical Center's hospital, clinics and its fitness center, plus a nearby EMS station. 
 As of 8 a.m. Nov 10, five Spectrum customers had reported outages in Waynesville, according to Downdetector. 
 Spectrum said it had crews servicing a widespread outage in the area. 
 Outages near East and Main Streets in Waynesville began around midnight, according to residents. Some people living in Clyde, Canton and Beaverdam also reported outages overnight and into Tuesday morning. 
 Internet was restored just before noon on Tuesday.
